message: Goal: night light - LED off in room light (>=30 lx), on at dusk (<=3 lx) and in the dark, 8-15 mA; cheapest parts (LDR + two 2N3904).

note: First design: RTOP 47k over a GL5528 LDR (switch near 7 lx), Darlington 2N3904, RL 220 ohm, white LED
Fix: night current 5.9 mA (white LED 3.0 V + Darlington 0.75 V leave 1.25 V on RL); RL 220 -> 100 ohm
Add a sunset test: light falls 50 lx -> 1 lx in 1 s steps to find where the LED switches on (events can now change an LDR: pow() in alter expressions)
Sunset test description matches the result (about 4 mA at 9 lx, 6 mA at the 7 lx step)

message: Goal: measure the switching point directly with a dc sweep of the light
